en.headline: KMB bus hits overhead sign at new Huanggang port, no injuries
en.dek: The Transport Department said it had asked franchise bus operators to strengthen driver training after a B11 double-decker entered the wrong lane on Saturday afternoon.
body: A Kowloon Motor Bus B11 double-decker struck an overhead traffic sign at the new Huanggang port on Saturday afternoon after the driver was suspected of taking the wrong route. No one was injured.

Police received a report at about 3.04pm that the bus, travelling from Tin Fu in Tin Shui Wai, had entered the lower-level cross-boundary coach waiting area under the joint inspection building and hit a sign suspended from the ceiling. The vehicle showed no major damage.

This is the second similar incident involving a KMB bus at the port in two weeks. On 18 October a B10 bus entered the same area and struck a sign, cracking an upper windscreen. The new Huanggang port opened on 12 October.

The Transport Department said it was concerned about the incident and had required franchise bus operators to strengthen drivers’ route and driving training to ensure safety and smooth operation at the public transport interchange serving the port.

zh.headline: 九巴B11皇崗口岸撞天花指示牌 無人受傷
zh.dek: 運輸署表示關注事件，已要求專營巴士營辦商加強車長駕駛及路線培訓，確保往返皇崗口岸交匯處暢順安全。
body: 周六下午約3時，一輛九巴B11路線雙層巴士在新皇崗口岸疑因行錯路，撞到天花懸吊的交通指示牌。事件中無人受傷。
警方接報指，由天水圍天富開往口岸的巴士駛進聯檢大樓底層跨境巴士候車區時撞上路牌。現場照片顯示巴士未見明顯損毀。
這是兩星期內九巴在該口岸發生的第二宗同類意外。10月18日一輛B10巴士亦誤入同一區域撞到指示牌，上層擋風玻璃破裂。新皇崗口岸於10月12日啟用。
運輸署回覆查詢時表示關注事件，已要求專營巴士營辦商加強車長的駕駛和路線培訓，確保道路安全及暢順往返皇崗口岸公共運輸交匯處。
